Sach kya hai?
✅ Raat ko aam taur par emergency operation hote hain — jo subah tak rukna theek nahi
✅ Emergency mein zaroorat se zyada deri khud nuksaan kar sakti hai
✅ Planned (pehle se tay) operation aam taur par din mein rakhe jaate hain
✅ Emergency ke liye OT team 24 ghante taiyaar rehti hai — koi sawaal ho toh doctor se poochhiye
